meta.datePolicy: The original date strings are preserved exactly where available. No missing year or day assignment has been inferred.
meta.scopeNote: The repository did not contain the source itinerary at handoff. Entries and date strings present in the session research notes are retained; uncertain day assignments remain unassigned rather than being reconstructed. All confirmed values are linked to official sources.
meta.currencyNote: KRW values are reproduced from the linked official source and are time-sensitive. No USD conversion or trip total is calculated.

entries.name: AREX airport transfer
entries.planned: AREX $7 / 45 minutes
entries.officialFacts: AREX has Express and All-stop services with different durations and fares. Official indexed route information lists Express journeys at about 43 minutes from Terminal 1 / 51 minutes from Terminal 2, and All-stop journeys at about 59 / 66 minutes. The indexed fare display is time-sensitive and the live page did not load as text in this research session.
entries.reviewNote: The supplied $7 / 45-minute value does not identify the service, terminal, fare basis, or exchange rate. Do not treat it as a confirmed ticket or schedule.
